# independent brute-force verification of the worst-case diagnostic optimum
import itertools, json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import run, prof, query, rec
CHAINS = 20
chain_records = []
for k in range(1, CHAINS + 1):
    for i in range(k):
        chain_records.append(rec('h%d.l%d.test.' % (k, i), 'CNAME', 'h%d.l%d.test.' % (k, i + 1)))
    chain_records.append(rec('h%d.l%d.test.' % (k, k), 'A', '192.0.2.%d' % (k % 256)))
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': chain_records}],
       'profiles': [prof('p%d' % m, m) for m in range(8)],
       'queries': [query('k%02d' % k, 'h%d.l0.test.' % k, 'A', k) for k in range(1, CHAINS + 1)],
       'observations': []}
t0 = time.time(); p = run(doc); print('elapsed %.2fs' % (time.time()-t0))
out = json.loads(p[1])
sig = lambda r: (r['rcode'], frozenset((x['owner'],x['type'],x['data']) for x in r['answer']))
matrix = {(r['query'], r['profile']): sig(r) for r in out['runs']}
costs = {q['id']: q['cost'] for q in doc['queries']}
pids = sorted(p['id'] for p in doc['profiles']); qids = sorted(costs)
pairs = []
for a,b in itertools.combinations(pids, 2):
    d = frozenset(q for q in qids if matrix[q,a] != matrix[q,b])
    if d: pairs.append(d)
print('requirements:', len(pairs), 'useful queries:', len(set().union(*pairs)))
best=None
for size in range(1, 21):
    for combo in itertools.combinations(qids, size):
        s=set(combo)
        if any(not (d & s) for d in pairs): continue
        key=(sum(costs[q] for q in combo), size)
        if best is None or key < best[0]: best=(key,combo)
print('brute-force optimum cost/count/basis:', best)
print('submission says:', out['diagnostic'])
PYEOF
